additional_info.subject: RE: ID0370671-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312571675/17] OCPP Offline CRM:01811000180
additional_info.body:
Hello ﻿Maxime Maucler,﻿
I hope this message finds you well. I wanted to provide an update regarding the connectivity issue with the EV charger you reported.
After thorough investigation, it has been determined that the problem does not lie with the connectivity but rather with the SIM card in the charger. The SIM card is either defective or missing, which is causing the communication issue.
Our service team will contact you to conduct further investigation.
Thank you for your understanding.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
